name: Urdala_Trol
summary: Urdala_Trol is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses a trailing stop mechanism based on the ATR indicator to dynamically adjust stop-loss levels as price moves in favor. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and manages them with an adaptive trailing algorithm. The EA is designed for medium-to-long-term trend capture on higher timeframes.
summary_zh: Urdala_Trol是一个趋势跟踪型EA，使用基于ATR指标的移动止损机制，随着价格朝有利方向移动动态调整止损水平。它在趋势方向上开仓，并通过自适应追踪算法管理仓位。该EA专为中长线趋势捕捉设计，适用于较高时间周期。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过识别市场趋势方向进行顺势交易。入场条件基于趋势判断指标，当确认趋势方向后开仓。出场条件主要依赖ATR动态追踪止损，当价格回撤超过ATR计算的一定倍数时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，通过ATR倍数设定止损距离来控制单笔风险。整体策略逻辑简洁，专注于让利润奔跑同时用追踪止损保护已获利润，但缺乏明确的入场信号过滤和多重确认机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, entering positions in the direction of the identified market trend. Entry conditions rely on trend direction indicators, opening positions once the trend is confirmed. Exit conditions primarily depend on an ATR-based dynamic trailing stop, closing positions when price retraces beyond a calculated ATR multiplier. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a balance-proportional lot calculation method. Money management controls per-trade risk by setting stop-loss distance through ATR multiplier calculations. The overall strategy logic is concise, focusing on letting profits run while protecting gains with trailing stops, but it lacks explicit entry signal filtering and multi-confirmation mechanisms.

pros: ATR动态追踪止损能有效适应市场波动率变化，在不同行情下自动调整止损距离
趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，让利润奔跑的同时保护已获浮盈
参数简洁明了，用户易于理解和调整，降低了误配置风险
pros_en: ATR-based dynamic trailing stop effectively adapts to market volatility changes, automatically adjusting stop distance under different conditions
Trend following strategy logic is clear, letting profits run while protecting unrealized gains
Parameters are concise and user-friendly, easy to understand and adjust, reducing misconfiguration risk
cons: 缺乏明确的趋势判断和入场信号过滤机制，可能导致震荡行情中频繁开仓止损
没有独立的止损设置，完全依赖追踪止损，若价格瞬间跳空可能造成较大亏损
缺少加仓和减仓逻辑，无法在趋势确认后逐步建仓以优化成本
cons_en: Lacks explicit trend determination and entry signal filtering mechanism, potentially leading to frequent stop-outs in ranging markets
No independent stop-loss setting, relying entirely on trailing stop, which may cause large losses on price gaps
Missing position scaling logic, unable to gradually build positions after trend confirmation to optimize entry cost
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤指标（如ADX）以避免震荡行情中的虚假信号
加入固定最大止损作为安全网，防止追踪止损在极端行情下失效
实现分批建仓和分批平仓机制，提高资金利用效率和风险分散能力
improvements_en: Add trend strength filter indicators (e.g., ADX) to avoid false signals in ranging markets
Add a fixed maximum stop-loss as a safety net to prevent trailing stop failure in extreme market conditions
Implement position scaling for both entry and exit to improve capital efficiency and risk diversification

risk_points: 无固定止损保护，极端跳空行情下追踪止损可能失效导致较大亏损
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
震荡行情中可能反复触发入场和止损，产生连续小额亏损累积
risk_points_en: No fixed stop-loss protection; trailing stop may fail during extreme gap events causing large losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions within the same bar
May repeatedly trigger entries and stops in ranging markets, accumulating consecutive small losses

summary_en: Urdala_Trol is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses a trailing stop mechanism based on the ATR indicator to dynamically adjust stop-loss levels as price moves in favor. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and manages them with an adaptive trailing algorithm. The EA is designed for medium-to-long-term trend capture on higher timeframes.
